item.title: Gaddar State Film Awards for 2025: Naga Chaitanya Named Best Actor for ‘Thandel’, Rashmika Mandanna Wins Best Actress for ‘The Girlfriend’
item.description: The Telangana government on Saturday announced that actor Naga Chaitanya had been chosen as the Best Actor for 2025 for his performance in 'Thandel', while actress Rashmika Mandanna had been chosen as the Best Actress for her performance in 'The Girlfriend'.

item.title: World News | Finnish President Alexander Stubb Concludes India Visit as Ties Elevated to 'Strategic Partnership'
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on World at LatestLY. item.title: ‘Ramayana: Part One’ Makers POSTPONE Grand Showcase Event in Mumbai Amid Iran-Israel War – Reports
item.description: The grand showcase event for Nitesh Tiwari’s 'Ramayana: Part One', originally set for Ram Navami at the Gateway of India, has been postponed to May 2026 due to the ongoing Iran-Israel conflict. The mythological film stars Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash in the lead roles.

item.title: Tecno Modular Smartphone Price, Features and Specifications
item.description: Tecno unveiled the ATOM at MWC 2026, the world’s thinnest modular smartphone. Featuring a magnetic snap-on system and physical pins, it allows users to swap cameras, batteries, and speakers. While the Tecno modular smartphone price remains a concept estimate, the ATOM features represent a major leap in repairability and sustainable tech.

item.title: International Women's Day 2026: PM Narendra Modi Praises India’s Nari Shakti, Says Women Are Breaking Stereotypes and Driving Nation-Building
item.description: PM Narendra Modi on Sunday said that as India progresses further, the aspirations and contributions of women will continue to guide India's collective journey towards a strong and prosperous nation. He also shared how women are now breaking away from the stereotypes by entering a profession that was considered "not for women".
